no_tuning: No constant is chosen on a test portion or on the evaluation set. No threshold is fitted or swept in this job. All routing, retrieval and selection constants are inherited. The SERF-v3 motivation from SERF-v1 test analysis is described in protocol_serf_v3.json.

variants.base: Existing centralized_adapter unchanged, including its public argpartition tie behavior.
variants.+sel: Imported pooled coverage selector over every online client with indexed pages, with the original scores and tie rules.
variants.+sel+test: Same selection plus the recorded availability decision, checked from scores over every eligible client including offline clients.

retriever.score: w * cosine(visual) + (1 - w) * [d * cosine(dense) + (1 - d) * cosine(tfidf)]

seeds.federation_rule: public seed + client count + (0 for finrag, 50000 for visdom)

public.mask: Reuse unchanged run_v3_plan.online_mask. Original public plans encode scenario IDs rather than explicit masks; check offline_clients on any row that carries it.
public.views: Import Job B query_views, whose full and slot scoring and QueryViews construction match Job A and run_v3_plan exactly. Import Job A plan_row and metric_fields.
public.availability_source: Job B public_gate over the same recorded public_paired_v1 S2G-RAG+avail, S2G-RAG and FedResolve rows; verify _critical_missing and Job B recorded gate.
public.serf_source: Job A FedResolve +sel full rows cross-checked with original serf_v3 plan rows and registered/v3_cells.csv. Paired rows from Job B cross-checked with original serf_v3 plans.

composite.source: Read Job C composites.jsonl test definitions and queries cache, with no new encoding.
composite.availability_source: Recorded Job C availability_decision and offline_clients; check all recorded methods and policies agree and verify score-only test. Use budget-2 masks and decisions also at budget 3.
composite.serf_source: Job C FedResolve-v3 native selection and native policy, verify stored metrics and calls without routing.
composite.missing_reference_policy: Job C has offline scenarios only at budget 2. Emit new budget-3 offline global rows, mark the corresponding SERF comparisons unavailable, and never recompute SERF or substitute another budget.

evaluation.runner: Fixed run_formal_gold_v1.py; cached scores through Job B build_inputs, coverage from imported gold_v3.v3_select. Decisions saved before annotation content is loaded. Only unchanged metric functions consume annotations.
evaluation.serf_source: Job A evaluation FedResolve +sel rows on all-online questions, verify fixed metrics and recorded gold_v3_results.json summaries. Job B fixed SERF-v3 rows on paired scenarios, verify gate and metrics without re-routing.
evaluation.availability_source: Job B evaluation_paired FedResolve-v3 gate; verify imported public _critical_missing on fixed combined scores and probabilities.
evaluation.enumeration: enumerate_single_offline.py has hardcoded METHODS and EXTERNAL, no extra method argument, and writes beside its source. It needs changes to include +sel+test safely.

metrics.evidence_recall: Public page units for finrag and deduplicated document units for visdom, using unchanged metric_fields.
metrics.part_recall: Job C evidence_metrics: fraction of the two parts with at least one relevant unit.
metrics.complete_evidence_composite: Both parts have at least one relevant unit.
metrics.owner_contacts: Distinct owners of selected page IDs, using Job B ownership mapping. Zero on public/composite abstention. Evaluation retains evidence IDs on abstention as fixed item_metrics does.
metrics.calls: SERF client_calls from recorded rows. Global variants retain one central-store call if a proposed page exists, with owner_contacts separately for contact comparisons. The pool client list is not a charged route.
metrics.evaluation: Unchanged strict_success, evidence_recall, evidence_precision, citation_f1 and bytes from fixed item_metrics. Keep centralized queried_clients equal to all online candidate owners; do not replace them by cited-page owners for strict success.
metrics.balanced_accuracy_public: Half answerable rate (any relevant cited unit and no routing abstention) plus half unanswerable abstention rate.
metrics.balanced_accuracy_composite: Half answerable complete-evidence rate without abstention plus half part_offline abstention rate.
metrics.balanced_accuracy_evaluation: Fixed runner/Job B criterion: complete_client_set and no routing abstention on answerable scenarios, routing abstention on unanswerable scenarios.
metrics.selected_pages: Length of selected_page_uids. Public/composite evidence IDs are empty on abstention; evaluation retains them to match the fixed metric runner.

cost.accounting: Original plan request/response/protocol fields and a central-store call for global ranking. Owner contacts reported separately. Evaluation serialized request and response bytes are null; fixed image bytes plus certificates define bytes.

statistics.order: Stable sorted (config,uid,scenario), which is sorted uid within a setting.
statistics.primary: SERF minus every global variant; public evidence recall and contacts; composite part recall, complete evidence and contacts; evaluation evidence recall. Per setting, with number of four settings whose interval excludes zero.
statistics.mcnemar: Imported e2e_stats.mcnemar, exact two-sided binomial. Composite complete evidence pooled by (config,uid), evaluation strict success over questions; paired scenarios on each answerability side per setting. Use the identical exact scipy.stats.binom tail at discordance of at least 1024, preventing integer conversion overflow and probability underflow.
statistics.paired_comparisons: SERF against each global variant; +sel+test against +sel and recorded Centralized + test. Every side and both sign directions reported.
statistics.reporting: Both signs of each difference and both discordance directions, regardless of outcome. Reverse intervals are exact negations. No multiple-comparison adjustment or outcome-based selection.
statistics.aggregation: Per-setting query means, then unweighted mean of exactly four settings separately by dataset, budget, scenario, method and variant. Empty or missing settings give null macro means; no silent intersection. Evaluation averages 45 questions, and scenario sides use their own denominators. Repeated public queries across settings make pooled composite inference descriptive.

execution: CPU only; no generation. Inputs and source modules remain read-only; outputs use exclusive creation under the control artifact directory. First N test queries per setting in upstream order for --limit.
